finding.summary: In start_queued(), status.save_queue(queue) is called before loop.start(key, folder, OPS). If loop.start() raises (e.g. tmux refuses the tab), the ticket has already been removed from the persistent queue but never started, causing permanent ticket loss.
finding.fix: Only save the queue after loop.start() succeeds, or re-add the ticket to the front of the queue and re-save if start fails before propagating the exception.

label: false_positive
label_reason: `loop.start` writes the ticket's status file (with `launch_dir`) before opening the tab, so a failed start never leaves the ticket in neither place; since d2309a5/c3e9e57 a refused tab undoes the start and puts the ticket back at the front of the queue. Re-adding it while it is active would start it twice.
